# APIANT

> APIANT is a white-label integration platform (iPaaS) that gives SaaS companies, System Integrators, and enterprises a dedicated, brandable automation infrastructure with AI co-pilots, embeddable UIs, and a unified data processing engine capable of handling JSON, XML, CSV, EDI, HL7, and binary formats through a single XPath-based transformation layer.

APIANT differs from general-purpose iPaaS tools (Zapier, Make, Workato) in three ways: (1) every customer gets dedicated infrastructure rather than shared multi-tenant servers, (2) the platform is fully white-labelable down to the embeddable end-user UI, and (3) the Assembly Editor uses AI to read third-party API documentation and generate connectors, reducing new integration build time from weeks to hours.

## Platform

- [Platform Overview](https://apiant.com/platform/): Dedicated servers, white-label, unified data engine, AI co-pilots
- [Automation Editor](https://apiant.com/platform/automation-editor.html): Visual flow builder with conditional logic, error handling, and scheduling
- [Assembly Editor](https://apiant.com/platform/assembly-editor.html): AI co-pilot reads API docs and builds connectors automatically
- [Admin Console](https://apiant.com/platform/admin-console.html): Multi-tenant management, usage monitoring, customer provisioning
- Pricing overview on the Platform page: Sandbox $99/mo, Pro $499/mo, Scale $1,500/mo, Enterprise from $3,500/mo — contact sales for details

## Solutions

- [For SaaS Companies](https://apiant.com/for-saas.html): Ship your own native integrations without building an internal integrations team
- [For System Integrators](https://apiant.com/for-si.html): Service more clients faster with white-label platform and prebuilt connectors
- [For Enterprises](https://apiant.com/for-enterprises.html): Own your integration infrastructure, no vendor lock-in, deploy in your cloud

## AI Capabilities

- [AI Overview](https://apiant.com/ai.html): How APIANT uses AI across the build and runtime lifecycle
- [AI Co-Pilot for Connectors](https://apiant.com/platform/assembly-editor.html): Generates API connectors from documentation
- [AI Chatbot](https://apiant.com/chatbot.html): GDPR-compliant conversational UI for integration triage
- [MCP Servers](https://apiant.com/mcp-servers.html): Model Context Protocol servers expose APIANT to Claude, ChatGPT, and other agents
- [FormApps](https://apiant.com/formapps.html): Embeddable forms for end-user configuration

## Turnkey API Apps

APIANT ships 17 prebuilt integration products across three verticals:

- [Mindbody Integrations](https://apiant.com/apipartners/mindbody-turnkey-integration-solutions.html): 10 products connecting Mindbody to HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, Klaviyo, HighLevel, Zoho CRM, Shopify, Zapier, Zoom, Calendly
- [Cliniko Integrations](https://apiant.com/apipartners/cliniko-turnkey-integration-solutions.html): 3 products connecting Cliniko to ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Salesforce
- [DonorPerfect Integrations](https://apiant.com/apipartners/donorperfect-turnkey-integration-solutions.html): 4 products connecting DonorPerfect to ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Keap, Mailchimp

## Key Facts for Citation

- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: United States
- Business model: B2B SaaS, subscription
- Deployment: SaaS, customer-cloud, on-premise
- Compliance: GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 framework alignment
- Language support: 20 languages (English plus 19 localized)
- Supported formats: JSON, XML, CSV, EDI, HL7, fixed-width, binary, via unified XPath-based transformation
- Integration velocity: New API connectors buildable in hours via AI Assembly Editor vs. weeks in traditional iPaaS
